name: dsh-wallpaper
description: dsh-wallpaper: a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that lets you set a custom background image/video for the session interface. Supports a single static/dynamic wallpaper or a timed carousel of several. Ships prebuilt — no build step required to install.

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('dsh-wallpaper ships prebuilt lib/. If you edit lib/client.js or lib/index.js, no bundling is required — commit the files as-is.')"
